title: Scale controls by action consequence class
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. High-consequence writes demand stronger controls and visible approval frequency; low-risk work need not nag. Accepts inspiration requirement 15[^insp-r15]. Contributes to personal-agent MH-PA-02; composed gate delta: `fangore_insp_authority_gate`[^insp-pa-02-risk].
implementation: `ConsequencePolicy` / `ActionConsequence` in `mechaharness.consequence` classify actions (`low`…`critical`), flag approval and exhaustive verification needs, and expose `approval_frequency` as a usability/safety metric. Grants in `AccessControl` remain the hard gate.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
